title: Exterior colour and paint choices
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise the car’s exterior colour, paint shades, and available colour options, while many other mentions only note colour without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the colour as attractive, well matched to the car, and supported by appealing paint or colour choices such as Thundernight Purple.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions refer to colour descriptively or ambiguously, so the examples are insufficient to confirm a clear opinion.

limitations: The sampled fragments are narrowly focused on colour and paint, but many undetermined examples are too brief or ambiguous to classify as clearly positive or negative.
Examples are heavily concentrated in GB reviews, with very limited evidence from other countries.
This is a stratified sample of topic fragments rather than a representative estimate of all reviews.
